description: No credential or login required. Reads the result of a job this connection already started, again, from its job_id. Starts no new job, sends nothing to any institution and spends no usage tokens. Use it when a call timed out while the job kept running (the error's data carries the job_id and a ready result_tool_call), or when a download_url in artifacts[] has expired: every call signs fresh links that work for 15 minutes, and the files themselves are kept for 7 days after the job. If the job is still running it waits up to 60 seconds, then says so - call it again a little later. Only jobs made by this account on this lane (demo or production) can be read.

job_id.description: The job_id of an earlier call, exactly as returned (job_ followed by 26 characters) - in data.job_id of a timeout error, or in job_id of a result that carries artifacts[].
